MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NAME: Gram
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.ORIGIN:
Odin thrust it into Branstock, and only Sigmund could pull it out.
Odin himself broke it, and Regin forged it anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_INT:
Deep inside the tomb, a blade broken in two is ringing.
Gram, the sword Odin broke with his own hand.
As Regin did, the two pieces must be forged anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SAF: Set the pieces together and slowly forge them anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_GAM: Test the new blade by striking the anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SUC: The new blade split the anvil in two.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SHA: Gram broke in two once more. Still, the blade does not leave the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.NAME: Ganjiang & Moye
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.TAGLI: A male and a female sword, finished after three years by a smith couple who put their hair and nails into the furnace.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.COST: Takes 2 slots · Max HP -6 the first time
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.ORIGI:
The king ordered the swords made within three months.
The couple finished the two blades after three years.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.FORGE:
The iron will not melt. The three-month deadline has long passed.
They say the smith couple put their hair and nails into the furnace.
A pair of swords finished after three years, with three hundred children working the bellows.
Human spirit is lacking. Put something greater into the furnace.
The male and female blades ring with one voice.
The male and female blades melt down together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.NAME: Kusanagi
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.TAGLI: The sword that gathers the clouds of heaven; the grass-cutting sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.COST: Lose HP when a combat in which it was summoned ends · Can be switched to only twice per combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.ORIGI:
Susanoo found the sword inside the tail of the eight-headed serpent.
In a wildfire, it cut the grass and opened a way.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.FORGE:
Clouds gather at its tip. Its first name was the sword that gathers the clouds of heaven.
It is the blade Susanoo found inside the tail of Yamata no Orochi.
After it cut the grass in a wildfire, it became the "grass-cutting sword".
Polish it with care, as one tends a sacred treasure.
Carry it back into the wildfire.
The clouds part and the blade grows clear.
An unexplained fever rises. It was once said that Emperor Tenmu's illness was this sword's doing.
As the sword was once moved from the palace to Atsuta Shrine, it is enshrined deep within the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.STAGE: One of the Three Sacred Treasures
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.NAME: Tyrfing
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.TAGLIN: It never misses and always grants victory.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.COST: From level 3: a curse each of the first 3 times you use it (three evil deeds)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.ORIGIN:
A sword the dwarves Dvalinn and Durin forged as the price of their lives.
Each time it is drawn, someone dies.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.FORGE_:
A golden hilt, a blade that shines like flame.
The dwarves Dvalinn and Durin made it as the price of their lives.
It never misses and never rusts, but each time it is drawn it must kill someone.
Hone it on the whetstone without drawing it.
Draw the blade, knowing that someone will die.
Iron and stone part like cloth.
Another of the dwarves' curses awakens.
The blade turned on its master. Svafrlami, too, died by this sword. Tyrfing is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.NAME: Dáinsleif
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.TAGL: Dáinn's legacy. A wound it scratches never heals.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.COST: Cannot gain Block while it is your current sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.ORIG:
Högni drew this sword.
From that day on, the battle never ends.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.FORG:
Dáinn's legacy, a sword made by the dwarf Dáinn.
When Högni drew it, reconciliation became impossible.
The battle repeats forever.
Even out the edge without leaving the sheath.
The blade remembers a path that never misses.
The sound of an endless battle will not leave your ears.
The blade will not return to its sheath. Dáinsleif is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.NAME: Durandal
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.TAGLI: A sword that holds holy relics and cannot be broken.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.COST: Cannot be switched to at 30% HP or less
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.ORIGI:
From an angel to Charlemagne, from Charlemagne to Roland.
Struck against a rock ten times, it did not take a single nick.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.FORGE:
Inside the golden hilt: a tooth of Saint Peter, the blood of Saint Basil, hair of Saint Denis, a piece of the Virgin Mary's clothing.
The sword Roland struck against a rock ten times without a single nick.
Clean the relics in the hilt one by one.
Strike it against the rock ten times.
Without a single nick, it has grown harder.
Instead of a nick, the rock stays in your hand.
As with Roland, the sword hides away beneath someone's body.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.NAME: Sköfnung
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.TAGLI: The finest sword of the North, home to the souls of twelve berserkers.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.COST: Cannot be used on the first turn of combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.ORIGI:
A sword taken from the grave of Hrólf Kraki.
Sunlight must never touch its hilt.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.FORGE:
The sword of Hrólf Kraki, called the best of all swords ever carried in the North.
The souls of the twelve berserkers who guarded the king dwell in it.
Taboo: sunlight must never touch its hilt.
In the shade, wrap the hilt and hone the edge.
Wake the twelve souls and call them into the blade.
Twelve breaths overlap on the blade.
The stone that heals its wounds has slipped into your pack.
Sunlight touched the hilt. The sword that came out of a grave vanishes again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.NAME: Onimaru
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.TAGLIN: The blade that moved by itself and cut down an oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.COST: Sometimes attacks with a random kind in normal combats
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.ORIGIN:
A blade recorded in the Taiheiki.
It cut down a demon without its master's hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.FORGE_:
Without its master's hand, the sword moves by itself.
The Taiheiki records that it moved on its own and cut down an oni.
A tachi the Kyōhō Meibutsuchō named the foremost of five.
Let the blade swing once, as it wishes.
Set the blade free to move by itself.
The blade moves faster, on its own.
The blade slips your hand and moves as it pleases.
The blade leaves on its own, hunting oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.STAGE3: One of the Five Swords Under Heaven
The Torch of Nuada, the Sword of Light.
All Light fades if another sword is current at the end of your turn

One of the four treasures brought from Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.

The Sword of Light, also called the Torch of Nuada.
One of the four treasures of the Tuatha Dé Danann, brought from the northern city of Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.
Gather light while it rests in the sheath.
Draw it from the sheath in one motion.
A light no one can resist settles on the blade.
Your arm goes numb. You think of Nuada, who lost his arm and gave up the throne.
The light goes out, and the sheath is empty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.NAME: Caladbolg
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.TAGL: Fergus's sword, which grew vast enough to split the sky and cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.COST: Deals less damage when there is only one enemy
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.ORIG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound.
It cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.FORG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound. Its name means "hard cleft" or "hard blade".
When Fergus mac Róich raised it to strike, the blade grew vast enough to split the sky.
That blade cut the tops off three hills.
Lower the point and dress the hard blade.
Raise it until it grows vast enough to reach the sky.
The top of a hill has been cut away.
The point stopped before the king. It could not strike what it should have struck.
The blade vanishes beyond the hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.FULL_NOTE: [red]The tomb has no room. A sword must be sent back.[/red]
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ACQUIRED_AGAIN: [gold]{Sword}[/gold] has returned to the tomb. Its sleeping cards return with it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SHATTER_RULE: lose the sword (its cards are stored in the tomb)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NIBELUNG: A tuft of wool set adrift on the river is cut apart the moment it touches the blade. The sword that slew Fáfnir has returned. ...And the Nibelung Treasure followed it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_RESONANCE_EVENT.page: Pass By
Call none of them. Gain [gold]{PassGold}[/gold] Gold.

The tomb's door opens again, this time from somewhere deeper.
The swords already floating at your side make room to welcome a new one.{FullNote}
Take No Sword
Instead, give one of your swords a [gold]Safe Upgrade[/gold] (level +1).
Pass By
Call none of them. Gain [gold]{PassGold}[/gold] Gold.

Ganjiang and Moye take two places in the tomb.
Offer {MaxHpCost} Max HP: human spirit is lacking.
Offer
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and take Ganjiang & Moye.
Go Back
Choose another sword.
You called none of them. The tomb's ringing fades.

Instead of welcoming a new sword, you temper the one at your side.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold]: level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_EPITAPH_EVENT.title: Epitaph of the Sword Grave
In a deep valley you stand before an epitaph carved where swords were buried.
Beneath the wooden plaque, a hilt juts out of the earth.
When you touch it, the tomb at your back hums low.
Pull It Out
Gain a magic sword you do not own.
Wrench It Free
Lose [red]{ForceHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose one of two magic swords.
Read the Epitaph
Lose [red]{ReadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Give one of your swords a [gold]Safe Upgrade[/gold] (level +1).
Cover It Up
Cover it with earth. Gain [gold]{CoverGold}[/gold] Gold.

You brush the earth aside and a blade appears: [gold]{Sword}[/gold].
{Tagline}
Take It
Bring this sword into the tomb. If there is no room, send one sword back.
Take Them
Offer [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP: human spirit is lacking. Bring Ganjiang & Moye into the tomb (2 slots).
Bury It Again
Return the sword to the earth.
You cover the blade with earth. Only the wooden plaque remains.

Ganjiang and Moye take two places in the tomb.
Offer {MaxHpCost} Max HP: human spirit is lacking.
Offer
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and take Ganjiang & Moye.
Give Up
Return the swords to the earth.
In the end, the hilt slipped from your hands.

You read the epitaph to the end. The sword at your side answers it.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold]: level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
You cover the hilt with earth. A few gold coins come up on your fingertips.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.EFFECT: Attacks deal extra damage equal to the upgrade level.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.EFFEC: Ganjiang: more attack damage / Moye: more Block. Alternate them for [Pair] bonuses.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.EFFEC: Inherits half of the previous sword's effect.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.EFFE: Played cards return to the draw pile instead of the discard pile.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.EFFEC: Attack damage you take is reduced.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.EFFEC: Attacks pile Scars on enemies. 12 Scars burst.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.EFFECT: Attacks on its own every turn. Stance cards change how.
Ending your turn with it charges Light. Unleash it with Draw-cut cards.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.STYL: Replay the same cards again and again
Charge Light, release it at once
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.POPUP_HEADER: A new cursed blade awakens in the tomb
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_RESONANCE_EVENT.page:
The tomb is full. [gold]{Sword}[/gold] needs {Slots} {Slots:plural:slot|slots}.
Which sword will you set free?
Its cards are stored in the tomb and return if you get it again. Its level resets to 0.
Set it free. ({Stage}, level {Level} · {Slots} {Slots:plural:slot|slots})
Go Back
Keep your swords and pick another.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.TIP:
The first time this sword reaches [gold]level 5[/gold], its legend card [gold]{Card}[/gold] is added to your deck. Once per run.
{Line}
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.FORGE_RESUL:
{Line}
[gold]The sword is complete[/gold] — legend card "{Card}" added to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.POPUP_REWAR: Added to your deck. It is one of this sword's cards, so it already fights at level 5.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.MASTERY: A tuft of wool drifting down the river parts on the edge by itself. The blade that slew Fafnir has returned.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.MASTE: After three hundred children worked the bellows, the male and female blades are finished at last, in three years.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.MASTE: With the mirror and the jewel, one of the Three Sacred Treasures that pass with the throne.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.MASTER: It never misses, never rusts, cuts iron and stone like cloth, and always gives victory to its bearer.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.MAST: It never misses, and no wound it scratches ever heals. The battle repeats forever.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.MASTE: Ten blows against the rock, and not a scratch.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.MASTE: The souls of all twelve berserkers who guarded the king now dwell in the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.MASTER: The tachi the Kyōhō Meibutsuchō named first among the five.
Drawn from its sheath of death, none escape it and none can resist it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.MAST: Raised to strike, it grows as wide as a rainbow and shears the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FAFNIRS_HEART_EVENT.title: Fafnir's Heart
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FAFNIRS_HEART_EVENT.pages:
Dragon's blood runs down over the pit. Gram has pierced Fafnir's heart.
Regin asked for the heart to be roasted. Sigurd, touching it to see if it was done, burned his finger, put it in his mouth, and so the tale goes, understood the birds.
"Regin will betray you. Eat the heart yourself."
Deeper in the lair lies the gold the dragon guarded.
Lose [red]{TasteHpLoss}[/red] HP. Upgrade [gold]Gram[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Fafnir's Heart[/gold] to your deck.

Gain [gold]{HoardGold}[/gold] Gold. Obtain the curse [red]Nibelung Treasure[/red].
The treasure will not follow again when Gram reaches level 5.

As the dragon's blood touches your tongue, birdsong turns into words. The blade answers them.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
You eat the heart. The dragon's strength smoulders slowly inside you.
You load the gold onto the cart. This hoard, they say, destroyed two royal houses.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BARROW_FIRES_EVENT.title: The Barrow Fires of Samsø
Fire flickers between the barrows of Samsø. The sons of the berserker Arngrim lie buried here.
Hervor, Angantyr's daughter, is said to have walked through these fires and called her father up from his grave. She asked for one thing only: Tyrfing, buried with him.
The dead man warned her that the sword would destroy her whole line.
Obtain [gold]Tyrfing[/gold]. If Mangeomchong is full, release a sword first. Then lose [red]{FireHpLoss}[/red] HP to the barrow fires.
Leave the sword in the grave. Remove a card from your deck.
The golden hilt is in your hand; the blade shines like flame. Behind you, the barrow fire scorches your cloak.
You turn your back on the barrow. Your step is lighter by what you left behind.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HOGNIS_ANSWER_EVENT.title: Högni's Answer
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HOGNIS_ANSWER_EVENT.pages:
Heðinn has carried off Hildr, Högni's daughter, and Högni has followed him to the island.
Heðinn offers much gold as atonement. Högni's answer, the story goes, was this:
"Too late. I have already drawn Dáinsleif. The dwarves made it: it must kill a man each time it is drawn, it never misses, and its wounds never heal."
At night Hildr wakes all the fallen. The battle begins again.
Upgrade [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Irreconcilable[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Gain [gold]{RansomGold}[/gold] Gold. [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] loses 1 level (nothing at level 0).
Lose [red]{HildMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Heal to full.

The sword will not go back into its sheath. Words of peace are lost under the ring of the blade.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.

You take the gold. Denied its blood, the sword growls low in its sheath.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
All night someone tends your wounds. You wake whole, yet with a little less of yourself.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.title: Roncevaux
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.INI:
The narrow pass of Roncevaux. The rearguard is already surrounded.
Three times Oliver begged Roland to sound the Olifant, and three times he refused. When at last he blew it, they say, he blew until his temples burst.
Dying, Roland struck Durendal against the rock so no enemy would take it. The blade did not take a scratch.
Lose [red]{HornHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Olifant[/gold] to your deck.
Upgrade [gold]Durandal[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Roland's Rock[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Rest with the sword and horn beneath you. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.HOR: The horn's call rolls far beyond the pass. You taste blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.ROC:
Ten blows. The rock splits; the blade only grows harder. The weight of the rock stays in your aching hands.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.RES: You close your eyes with the sword beneath you, where no enemy can take it. The strength to rise returns.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.title: Wildfire
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.pages.INIT:
In the middle of the field, fire leaps up on every side. Whoever lured you here has set the grass alight.
Yamato Takeru was trapped like this, the tale says. He cut the grass away with the sword his aunt Yamatohime had given him, and lit a counter-fire with the flint from the bag she gave him with it.
From that day the Sword of the Gathering Clouds was called Kusanagi, the Grass-Cutter.
Lose [red]{CutHpLoss}[/red] HP. Upgrade [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Remove a card from your deck.
You swing through the smoke. Where the grass falls, a path opens. The blade drinks in the firelight.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.pages.COUN: The counter-fire swallows the wildfire. Nothing useless is left where it passed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOKIMASAS_DREAM_EVENT.pag:
Every night a small oni comes into the sleeper's dreams to torment him.
According to the Taiheiki, Hōjō Tokimasa fell ill this way. An old man came to him in a dream, saying he was the sword: "Rust holds me in my scabbard. Clean it off, and I will drive the oni away."
Once cleaned and left standing unsheathed, the sword fell of its own accord and cut the head off the oni carved on a brazier stand, so the story goes.
Pay [gold]{PolishGold}[/gold] Gold. Upgrade [gold]Onimaru[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Remove a [red]Curse[/red] from your deck. (Needs a removable curse.)

Rust flakes away under the whetstone. That night, no oni came into your dreams.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
At midnight you wake to the sound of the sword falling on its own. One of the curses you carry lies cut in two.
You wrestle the oni all night. By morning you are worn out, but tougher than before.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T0: You again. A boy swinging a broken blade.
Broken or not, it still cuts.
Sigurd's hands never shook like this.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Draw me. The tomb is dull.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: Hmph. Not a dragon among them.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T0.0: Don't doze by the fire. The careless die first.
If you fall, let go of me first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T1: You're late. Call me first next time.
Fine. You get the first cut.
Loosen your wrist. I'll do the cutting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: I smell it. A tough one today.
That's why I woke you first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T1.0: If you're cleaning me, start with the edge.
I know. You say it every time.
Don't back down. One broken thing is enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: The seam is gone. Not bad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T2: Ensifer, eyes forward. I've got your back.
Good. Your hands are steady today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Draw me first. You always have.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: See that? We cut that down.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T2.0: Sigurd cleaned his blade by a fire like this.
Get up! You don't end here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: Feels like the days I split the anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T3: Your grip suits me better than Sigurd's. Surprisingly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Broken things get reforged. Both of us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: Better than the day I slew Fafnir.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T3.0: Ensifer. If every other blade leaves, I stay.
I know. It's been you from the start.
I'm here. You won't fall alone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: I'll remember this flame. You forged it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Where is Moye? Bring her out first.
I'm here. Don't make a fuss.
I'd rather melt than serve a king again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: 'Make it in three months,' they said. Humans always rush.
Not as hot as a furnace.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Pathetic. Will you fall in front of Moye?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Hair and nails went into this steel. Don't hammer it carelessly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Ah, it's you. Moye, he looks better today.
He does. His hands shake less.
I cut. Leave the guarding to Moye.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: I smell fire. A fight is near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Did you see, Moye? I struck first.
I miss the sound of three hundred children at the bellows.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Fall back! Moye and I will hold.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Ensifer, look after Moye. I'll open the way.
You've learned how to wield us both, haven't you?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: A good fight. You helped, too.
The couple who made us used to sit by a fire like this.
They always held hands by the fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Hold on. Our makers held on for three years.
Then I can manage a few turns.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Moye and I grow stronger together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: You're like a son to us.
I'll cut anything. The three of us are enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Ha! More satisfying than a king's neck.
Ensifer, sleep before the fire dies. We'll keep watch.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: I'd go back into the furnace before I lose you!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: What took three years, you've done.
Because you two waited for me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T0: Handle me gently. I'm not as sturdy as he is.
Are you the new master? You're so young.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T0.0: The firelight is warm. The furnace always hurt.
I'll guard you. Get behind me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: I'm a little sturdier now. Thank you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T1: We meet again. You look brighter today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Breathe first. No need to rush.
You're pale. I'll guard, so catch your breath.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T2: Call and I'll always come. You know that?
Ganjiang, he's become quite dependable, hasn't he?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Let's all three come home today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T2.0: Our makers used to laugh like this, too.
No, not yet. I'm right here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: It feels like being reborn in your hands.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T3: Stop it, both of you. It's embarrassing.
I'll go anywhere with you. Even into fire.
I'm not taking you into fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Don't get hurt. Promise me that much.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T3.0: Ensifer, someday hold something other than swords. Flowers, maybe.
I'm your shield. To the very end.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: Now I can stand beside Ganjiang with pride.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You summon a sacred regalia so lightly.
I called because I need you.
I know. I'll use them wisely.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The clouds hang heavy. Something impure draws near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: The filth is cleared. Wash yourself as well.
The night I cut the burning grass was this quiet, too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: What a sight. Susanoo would have laughed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Not hands fit for a regalia... but earnest ones.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You seek me again. I don't mind.
I'll carry on half the strength of the last blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The wind has turned. Time to take up the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Clean. Your swordwork too, a little.
When the clouds part, the stars appear. Rest.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Impurity has seeped into you. I'll draw it out.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Clouds gather at my tip. Not bad.
Closer to how you used to be?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: Call me. For you, two times are no waste.
Ensifer, today the wind is on your side.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The clouds of heaven gather for you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Well cut. I'd boast of it to Susanoo.
Even a regalia tires. Keep me close tonight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Don't retreat. I'll cut a path, as I did through the fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: The pact of two... with you alone, I wish it were more.
Two is enough. You never miss.
You're no master a regalia would serve. But as a friend, you'll do.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: Ensifer. Let us cut a path together again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Heh. The sky is clear. Thanks to you.
I'm more at ease beside you than my old masters. Strange.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Let me cleanse you. Don't fall, my friend.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: This blade, I offer to you.
Don't offer it. Just come with me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: You drew me. Now someone dies.
Everyone who held my golden hilt ended badly. So will you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: You won. I always grant victory. The price comes later.
Die now and the curse ends with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: The sharper I get, the deeper the curse. Still want this?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: I'm scared. I still have to.
I never miss. My only virtue.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Dvalin's curse is restless today. Be careful.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: A blade that never rusts never learns to rest.
Then I'll rest for both of us.
Fool. How would it look if my wielder died first?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: My flame-edge burns again. ...I won't thank you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: Ensifer. I'll bear the curse. You just cut.
Not even Angantyr cared for me like you do.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Draw me if you need to. Better than dying while you hesitate.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: Another win. This time... I'll pay the price.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: You sleep soundly beside a cursed blade.
No. You are not the one who dies this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: Back to the days I cut iron and stone. Let it serve something good this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: I'll carry the three evil deeds. You stay clean.
I said we'd carry them together.
I always grant victory. This time, I mean it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Ensifer. You may draw me. You, of all people.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: Only the enemy died. For once, the curse missed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: Not even Dvalin could have imagined a master like you.
I never imagined a blade like you, either.
Curse, hear me. Not him. Never him.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: I'll be the blade that always wins. For you alone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: Blood! You finally let me out!
Once drawn, I don't go back until I taste blood.
I know. That's why I drew carefully.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: A fight! A fight that never ends!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: I hate resting. Högni fought all night.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: I'd rather not taste your blood... yet.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: I've been waiting. Who do we cut today?
Drop the shield. You only need me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: I hear heartbeats. Yours, and theirs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: Heh, that was good. Let's fight longer next time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: The sheath is stifling. Let me stay out a bit.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: Hurt? Then we pay them back in blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Now the wounds I leave will run even deeper.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: Ensifer! Fighting with you is the best.
Don't worry. I won't drink your blood. Promise.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: Even an endless battle isn't bad with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: Strange. These days, the sheath isn't so bad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: Who made you bleed? I'll cut them all.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: When you forge me, I feel less thirsty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: When you call, I come faster than to the smell of blood.
I like you better than Högni. He never cared for me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: I'll end this fight too. For you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: I like your praise more than blood. Say it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: I'll go back in the sheath tonight. No blood needed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Even an endless battle is fine, if it's with you.
Let's make it one that ends.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: You called. This blade is swung for faith.
Roland struck me on stone ten times and could not break me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: The relics in my hilt tremble. Evil is near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Thanks be to God. And to you, a little.
I will pray. For you as well.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: You cannot take me up now. But I will pray beside you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: You'd lay hands on an unblemished blade? ...I feel your care, at least.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: Stand behind me. Guarding is my duty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: I think of Charlemagne's banners. March proudly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Well fought. Roland would have praised you.
Before a fire, all are equal. Saints and wardens alike.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Step back and breathe. You'll hold me again soon.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: The relics grow warm. A blessed hammering.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: Guarding you is now my faith.
That's a heavy thing to say.
I'm not the only unbreakable one. So are you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: The prayers are done. Now we fight together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: You never once fell back. I'm proud.
At the end, Roland tried to break me so no enemy would have me.
I'll make sure it never comes to that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: You're where I cannot reach. Please, come back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: The unblemished blade is yours now.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: My friend, today again I stand before you.
I think I finally know why the angel gave me to the world.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: No evil will touch you. Not while I stand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: To God, and to you. This time, equal thanks.
There is no holier duty than guarding your sleep.
Then I'll leave it to you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Even if you can't hold me, I'm here. To the end.
I know. I can feel it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: I'd rather be called Ensifer's sword than Roland's.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: The twelve of us are watching. Don't disappoint.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Let no sunlight touch the hilt. Wait before the first cut.
Fire is good. Sun is not.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: You bleed. A berserker would laugh.
I'm not in a laughing mood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: The twelve souls murmur. They watched your hammering.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: About three of the twelve have started to approve of you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Smells of a grave. Not ours. Theirs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: The twelve roar as one. A good fight!
King Hrólf held his feasts by a fire like this.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Rise! The king's berserkers never knelt!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: My edge remembers the northern cold again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: All twelve want to call you king. ...I refused.
Good. I don't want to be king.
Our souls brace your back. Don't be afraid.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: As one waits for sunset, wait out the first turn. Then it's our turn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: The twelve chant your name. Ensifer!
The barrow was cold and quiet. Beside you, it's loud and warm.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: We'll guard you as we guarded the king. All twelve!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: Thanks to you, we reclaim the name 'finest blade of the North.'
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: The twelve speak as one. You are our thirteenth.
First time since King Hrólf that we're glad to be drawn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Let the sun come. You'll be our shade.
We needn't return to the king's barrow. Our place is here.
Stay as long as you like.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Not one of the thirteen falls!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: In the name of the twelve berserkers, this blade is yours.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I need no master. I cut alone.
I know. Let's stay together anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.VICTOR: I only cut what needed cutting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: You don't have to talk. Let's rest.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: Give the order. I may listen.
I'm okay. I can still hold.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I've found a reason to move on my own. You.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.VICTOR: They called me first of the five. Today it was true.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: I learned from you that a fire is warm.
Whatever lays a hand on you, oni or man, I cut.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: Did you just say thank you?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I said I need no master. ...You're the exception.
I come even if you don't call. Always.
I know. That's why I feel safe.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: I'll stay till you sleep. And after.
Don't fall back. This time I'll be your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: Sharper now. Sharp enough to protect you.
You kept me in the dark so long. Dazzling, aren't I?
Hold another blade at turn's end and my light goes out. Remember.
So dark. If not now, when will you call me?
A campfire... a candle, next to me.
Once I was drawn, no one escaped. And yet you're the one losing.
I gathered light while I waited. You may praise me.
End your turn holding me. That's how the light builds.
Time to show them the light of Findias.
Hm, my light was rather beautiful today, wasn't it?
At night, even I dim a little. It's a secret.
Don't close your eyes. You need to see my light.
I see it. I still see it.
Stars flew from your hammer. I like it.
Ensifer, my light shines brightest in your hand.
Switch to the others if you like. Just come back to me at the end.
However deep the dark, it's daytime when we're together.
Shining with you, I was twice as bright.
Your face in the firelight isn't bad.
Spend all my light if you must. Just get up.
Not even Nuada polished me this carefully.
Just hearing you call me makes me shine.
The light no one escapes is now the light that guards you.
Let's go, Ensifer. Dazzling, as always.
See? Together, we turn night to day.
Tonight I'll be your light instead of the fire. Sleep well.
Don't go out! Stay where my light reaches!
Now I know. You're the reason I shine.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Ha! Cramped! No room to swing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: I'm the blade that cut three hills. These are nothing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: The fires on the fairy mound were bigger.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Hey, if you fall, who'll carry me?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: Bigger! Big enough to split the sky!
Then you won't fit in the Tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Here we go! How many today?
Up to three in one swing. More, two swings!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Refreshing! This is why we fight!
You look happiest in a fight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: Resting's not bad. Big swings need big rests.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Back off! I'll take one big swing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: My blade's harder! Leite would be amazed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Ensifer! For you, I'd cut ten hills!
Even one foe is fine. Fighting with you is fun.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Ha! Your hands have gotten used to my size!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: I like it here better than the fairy mound. The only loud one is me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: How dare they! Let's sweep them all away!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: This time I might really split the sky!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: You can call me big brother! ...No, let's be friends.
I'm more excited today than the day I cut three hills!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: However many there are, I'll clear your path.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: I'll keep quiet tonight. Just while you sleep.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Whoever knocks you down, I'll blast them along with the hill!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: The sky-splitting blade, I leave in your hands!
